name: Pork-brain herbal stew
summary: Pork brain stewed in its own pot with ginseng and Chinese herbs at Tài Ký, 39 Bùi Thị Xuân.
origin: Pork brain among the tiềm pots at Tài Ký, stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.
